Give AI full desktop and browser control
Author built a tool giving agents full desktop control plus a browser debugger extension, after OpenAI computer use refused menu bar interaction; used daily with Claude and Codex.
·
Nov 17, 2026
Done with
CL
Claude
CX
Codex
What they did
The author built a tool that gives an AI agent full desktop control, plus a browser debugger extension for working inside the browser. They made it because OpenAI's computer use was limited and refused to interact with the menu bar or task tray. The tool is MIT licensed and connects to Claude and Codex.
How it went
The author says they use it daily with Claude and Codex. The comment gives no numbers, benchmarks, or details on failures.
Worth knowing
The source is a brief comment with no setup steps or costs; check the linked machinecontrol.dev site for how to install and configure it.
Try it yourself
with
Claude
Copy prompt
Help me build a small tool that lets an AI agent control my [Mac/Windows/Linux] desktop, including menu bar and system UI clicks, and pairs with a browser extension for debugging pages. Start by listing the pieces we need, then build the simplest working version that can open [an app], click a menu bar item, and report what happened. Pause and show me the plan before running anything that changes system settings or deletes files.
Original source: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50528063
